description: Topics include: data entities and relationships; data modelling using Entity-Relation Diagrams: hierarchical, network and relational models of databases; query languages; physical representation of data in secondary storage; relational algebra and calculus as applied to the design of databases; security and integrity in the context of concurrent use; and basic ethical issues associated with database design and use.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of:
    • CSC225 - Algorithms and Data Structures I (1.5)
    • SENG265 - Software Development Methods (1.5)
supplementalNotes: • Credit will be granted for only one of CSC 370, CSC 470, HINF 200, HINF 300.
title: Database Systems
